title: This near-mint iPad refurb is only $315
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Get a near-mint Grade-A refurbished iPad 9th Gen with 256GB of storage on sale for $314.99 (reg. $479).

Buying a refurbished tablet can mean living with scratches, dents, or a worn case, but that’s not true for every refurb. If you want a tablet that looks close to new, try this Grade-A 9th Gen iPad on sale for $314.99 (reg. $479).

A Grade-A rating means this iPad is in near-mint condition with minimal to zero scuffing on the case. You get a tablet that looks almost new for $164 less than its regular price.

Beyond the price, this is also just a good tablet. Apple’s A13 Bionic chip keeps everyday apps, web browsing, and multitasking moving without lag. Text and video look sharp on the 10.2-inch Retina display, and stereo speakers make shows easy to hear without headphones. On video calls, the 12MP Ultra Wide front camera uses Center Stage to keep you in frame as you move.

At 256GB, this model has four times the storage of the 64GB version. That’s enough room for a large photo library, downloaded movies for a flight, and every app you use. Battery life runs up to 10 hours, and Touch ID unlocks the screen with your fingerprint.

This iPad is Wi-Fi only and works with the first-generation Apple Pencil, sold separately. A charging cable and power adapter are also included.

Get a Grade-A iPad 9th Gen on sale for $314.99.
